description: Real R-27ER1 air-to-air missile displayed at the entrance selfie point of the refurbished IAF Museum (opened 2021 with Kerala Tourism, re-dedicated 2 Sep 2026 by AOC-in-C SAC). Museum also shows a Rafale scale model (replica, not recorded), a MiG-21 KM-1 ejection seat, UB-16 rocket pods and a half-scale BrahMos model. Source NIE 3 Sep 2026, Times of India 2 Sep 2026.
